A high-energy cinematic action sequence inside a rain-soaked futuristic megacity at night. A sleek rescue hoverbike bursts through traffic, sparks flying from damaged neon signs, while a humanoid pilot weaves between towering buses, market stalls, and hovering police drones. The camera moves aggressively: fast dolly pushes, sweeping side tracking shots, sharp turns around corners, and a final low-angle chase shot as the vehicle jumps a broken skybridge. Lots of motion everywhere: rain sheets, steam blasts, debris, flapping fabric, flashing lights, reflections racing across wet pavement, people diving out of the way, drones banking hard, and the rider leaning into turns. Rich synchronized sound: roaring electric turbine, tire hiss on wet pavement, thunder, sirens Dopplering past, metallic impacts, glass shattering, crowd gasps, radio chatter, and a huge bass hit as the hoverbike lands. End with the pilot skidding to a stop in front of camera, engine pulsing, rain steaming from hot metal.
